units.source_text: 話又說回來，這種事對丈夫而言確實是不容置疑的打擊，

en.t: Come to think of it, for a husband such a thing is certainly an undeniable blow,

units.source_text: 但即便是「打擊」，也與沒完沒了湧來湧去的浪濤有所不同，

en.t: but even if it is a blow, it is different from waves that surge back and forth without end,

units.source_text: 擁有權利的丈夫可以通過憤怒，處理這種糾紛。

en.t: a husband with rights can deal with this kind of dispute through anger.

units.source_text: 可我的情況呢，身為丈夫卻沒有任何權利，

en.t: But in my case, though I was the husband, I had no rights at all,

units.source_text: 一想到這裡，就越覺得好像是自己的錯，

en.t: and whenever I thought of that, I felt more and more as if it were my own fault,

units.source_text: 別說憤怒了，我甚至連一句牢騷都不敢發。

en.t: far from getting angry, I did not even dare utter a single complaint.

units.source_text: 妻子是因為她與眾不同的優秀品質遭到了侵犯。

en.t: My wife was violated because of the exceptional quality that set her apart.

units.source_text: 而且，那種優秀品質也是丈夫早有的憧憬——

en.t: And that very quality was also something her husband had long yearned for:

units.source_text: 憐愛有加、純潔無瑕的信賴之心。

en.t: a tenderly lovable, pure and flawless trusting heart.

units.source_text: 純潔無瑕的信賴之心，也是一種罪過嗎？

en.t: Is a pure and flawless trusting heart also a sin?
